## Breaking

- The RPC `summary` output no longer has a `groups` field (#643). A terminal part of 0.16 still open loses its footer until it is restarted. Anyone reading the summary over RPC: drop any use of `groups`.

## Also

- 0.17.0 removed the `/courier memory` command and the memory view along with the rest of memory; its notes did not name them.

## What's Changed
* Mark the shrinking design as implemented by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/636
* Show the sender's title, not its session id, in a courier message's transcript line by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/637
* Design: tools by role (#633) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/638
* Offer a session that cannot start sessions only the tools it can use (#633) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/640
* Record the README demo with the sender's title in the Message from lines by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/642
* Add the /orchestrator-prompt command by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/641
* Remove the empty groups list from the tree summary by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/643
* Name queue among the dropped parameters and settle the shrinking design's open items by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/644
* Release 0.18.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/645


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.17.1...v0.18.0

0.17.1 changes one sentence a model reads. No tool, option or command changes.

## Changed

When a person types into a session that another session started, courier passes the text up to the sessions above it in a notice. That notice says courier cannot tell who sent the text. Sessions above could read this as a reason to overrule the session that received it: to tell it to do its task as first given, or to do the dropped part themselves. The notice now adds, after "acts on it.": "It decides what the text means for its part."

## Also in this version

The real-model checkers (maintainer tooling, not part of what the plugin does at run time) stop accepting what no run can do since 0.17.0: a report held in a join group, a finding sent ahead, a look through `courier_children` and a `courier_recall` call.

## What's Changed
* Shrink 5: remove the real-model checker allowances no run can use, after 0.17.0 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/629
* Tell the sessions above that a session decides what typed text means for its part by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/630
* Release 0.17.1 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/631


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.17.0...v0.17.1

0.17.0 is a breaking release: opencode-courier goes from 11 tools to 8 and from five options to three. Every session is offered less tool text, and a parent is woken by each report as it comes.

**Before you update:** let running session trees finish. No state of a removed feature is migrated.

## Removed, and what takes its place

| Removed | What takes its place |
|---|---|
| The tool `courier_children` | `courier_tree` |
| The tools `courier_recall` and `courier_note`, the `memory` option, lessons | Nothing |
| The command `/courier stop` | The `s` key in the tree panel (`/courier tree`); models still have `courier_stop` |
| The `group` parameter of `courier_spawn` (join groups) | Nothing: each report wakes its parent as it comes |
| The `finding` parameter of `courier_send` | A message to the parent without a status |
| The `queue` parameter of `courier_send` | Nothing: a working session reads a message at its next step |
| The `nativeChildren` option | `native: true` on a spawn |

## What you may notice

- **Options left in the config.** `memory` and `nativeChildren` are not read. Each is named once in the server log at load; remove them from the config.
- **Native children.** With `nativeChildren: true` gone, a child is an OpenCode subagent only when its spawn asks with `native: true`. To keep them, ask for native children in the prompt or in the project's instructions.
- **A fan-in costs more turns.** A parent that used a join group got one turn for all its reports; it now gets up to one turn per report.
- **`courier_tree` lists more.** Where `courier_children` returned a session's own children, `courier_tree` lists the tree, up to `maxTotal` sessions.
- **A tree running across the update.** A tree without a join group keeps running. A report held in a join group at the update stays undelivered; its text is in the child's own session, and a message asking the child to report again delivers it. A session with an old brief that passes `finding` has that text dropped.
- **A session that kept a `lessons` entry** naming `courier_recall` gets an unknown-tool error if it calls it.

## Left in storage

Keys under the prefixes `memory/` and `group/` stay on disk and are not read: titles, lessons and held report text. The plugin has no command that removes them.

## Kept

`courier_cancel`, the copy of text a person types into a child, `maxChildren`, per-spawn `native`, and the busy-time fallback are unchanged.

The design and its reasons: `docs/designs/shrinking-opencode-courier.md`.

## What's Changed
* Add the design for shrinking courier from 11 tools to 8 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/610
* Drop the busy-time fallback removal from the shrinking design by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/611
* Have the wave skill choose a model and an effort per issue by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/618
* Shrink courier from 11 tools to 8 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/627
* Release 0.17.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/628


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.16.4...v0.17.0

## What's Changed
* Tell a fork of a session in a tree that courier did not start it by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/607
* Tell a parent what OpenCode's own message at a native child's turn end is by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/608
* Release 0.16.4 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/609


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.16.3...v0.16.4

## What's Changed
* Move the plugin API pin to OpenCode 2.3.0 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/603
* Test OpenCode's reports of native children that are dropped, idle or stopped alone by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/605
* Release 0.16.3 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/606


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.16.2...v0.16.3
